 How to Watch Lakers vs Jazz
 When: Wednesday, November 18, 2026
 Time: 10:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: Spectrum SportsNet, Utah Jazz
 Live Stream: DIRECTV ( try for free )
 Los Angeles has been one of the NBA's hottest teams to open the 2026-27 season, entering Wednesday with a league-best 13-2 record. Luka Doncic continues to lead the charge, averaging nearly 39 points per game, while the Lakers are coming off a thrilling 118-114 overtime victory over the Charlotte Hornets. Quentin Grimes delivered a career-high 47 points and 10 three-pointers in that win, helping Los Angeles overcome an 18-point deficit.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Utah enters the matchup with some momentum of its own after snapping a 12-game losing streak with a 132-107 victory over the Clippers on Tuesday. Brice Sensabaugh exploded for 40 points, while Keyonte George added 30 points and 11 assists. The Jazz will look to carry that offensive production into Wednesday's contest against a Lakers team that defeated them 132-123 earlier this season, when Doncic erupted for 52 points.
